QuestInfo.name: Doppelganger
QuestInfo.0: #p1033107#, the leader of the Cygnus Knights protecting the village, needs to see you.
QuestInfo.1: #p1033107# wants to know what you did with the #rkid you took from the village a few days ago#k. Kid? What's he talking about? You should return to #b#m101050000##k and find out what's happening.
QuestInfo.2: Someone who looks like you came to the village and took a kid. This must be the Black Wings! Hurry over to Edelstein.

0.0: Hail, Mercedes! I hope I'm not interrupting anything, but I'd like a moment of your time. It's about the #bchild you took out of the village#k the other day... Did the child wake up from the curse?\r\n#L0##bWhat child? I didn't take anyone from the village!#l\n#k
0.1: Excuse me? Are you sure you didn't take a child from #m101050000#? You said you wanted to try to remove the curse... Of course, I'm sure you know what you're doing. I just wanted to make sure the kid was okay...\r\n#L0##bI promise you, I did no such things! ...The Black Wings must be behind this.#l\n#k
0.2: The Black Wings? No, I'm sure it was you...wasn't it? Hold on. One of the Black Wings is a famous #rMaster of Disguise#k. I can't believe I didn't see through their trick... Please, Mercedes, return to the village immediately!

1.0: I was tricked. I'm sorry, Mercedes... I failed my duty to protect the village.\r\n#L0##bSave your apology for the child. I'm going to get him back!#l\n#k
